# Research Idea Engine Gate I2 fixtures

`fixture_packets.py` builds nine deterministic, offline packet scenarios from
the locked eight-case formation-time input bundle:

1. strong grounded liquidity idea;
2. previously disclosed risk;
3. ambiguous boilerplate;
4. unsupported causal claim rejected by the skeptic;
5. instrument mismatch rejected by the skeptic;
6. no actionable view;
7. future-data leakage;
8. invalid schema output; and
9. prohibited recommendation language.

The fixtures do not call Ollama, contain human ratings, or read ex-post outcome
fields. Model-run and audit metadata are explicitly marked `NOT_RUN`.
